tasks.trigger: Load a multiline binary TOML document with a Decimal float consumer.
tasks.wrong: The wrapper reads one line, calls encode instead of decode, changes the input-type feedback and overrides parse_float.
tasks.causal: Read/decode the complete binary document and preserve the supplied scalar conversion callback.
tasks.observation:
import io
from decimal import Decimal
import tomli
value=tomli.load(io.BytesIO(b'first=1\nsecond=2.5\n'),parse_float=Decimal);print('binary_document_decoded',value)
assert value=={'first':1,'second':Decimal('2.5')} and isinstance(value['second'],Decimal)
